bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 40 × 40 × 20 cm are generally allowed, although individual shows may have tighter rules. Event lockers cost DKK 50 and measure 45 × 30 × 30 cm.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The official directions page provides arena parking and public transport guidance.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
